text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan managed to achieve
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phaaah... So good...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everything here is Trainer's treat,
right?
choice_data_list: Of course! It's a celebration party, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sweet. Imma invite my besties then.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks a bunch-pyo!
Thanks for the treat~☆

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Are you really sure, though?
Even treating us to this...”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Besides, an after-party is a total no-go unless everyone's there, right~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...If it weren't for the friends I have right here,
there's no way in hell I would've made it this far, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've been relying on your help constantly
ever since my debut race all the way to the Tenno Sho (Autumn), haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I just wanna say thanks.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Jordan...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So yeah! We're piggin' out today~! City said she'll meet up with us at karaoke~☆

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~â
choice_data_list: Does this keep going after this...?
Is there even more after this...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course! C'mon, Trainer.
Book us a karaoke booth~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, City just texted me.
Says she'll meet up with us in an hour!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's
do this, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, what's up~☆ If you're gonna do something fun, invite Golshi-chan too!☆"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, where to next?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay♪
Let's call Mac-chan over too~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What's with her?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even though you totally ignored me
when I texted you yesterday...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Tell 'em I said thanks, for what it's worth.
They did look out for me in their own way."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Don't make me say it out loud! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, you're coming to the after-party too.
Act as our guardian.
choice_data_list: I'll get you home before curfew, so don't worry.
I'll get you home before curfew, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. So inflexible.
Way too rigid. What are you, my guardian?
choice_data_list: You were the one who told me to act as guardian.
You're the one who told me to be their guardian.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aah, that's right!
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we held an appreciation party
for Tosen Jordan.
